targets.baseline_commit_message: collect-and-rank-viewer-questions: the old viewer-questions scripts, byte copies (first commit of a port)

preserve: a candidate is one sentence that ends in ?, has 6 to 40 words, and is the asker's own (first person or a direct question)
junk (links, removed, handles, adult and self-harm words) is never a candidate
a sentence already found (same letters and digits) is not found again
post titles count only when they end in a question mark
text is kept verbatim with its own link; nothing is rewritten
allowed_deltas: forum posts may be the forum harvest's forum-posts.jsonl (group) as well as reddit.jsonl (icp_segment)
video comments may be the channel harvest's comments.jsonl too
banned_substitutions: a second copy of this job in another folder
a person's bucket, code, segment, path or name written in code
_paths: The sources live in a private repository, so each is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of trillion-launch-video beside this one finds it.
